requirements.text: Authenticated users SHALL be able to create a organization.
Organization fields SHALL include name, description, logo/avatar, owner, status, createdAt, updatedAt.
The organization home SHALL list all boards the current user is authorized to discover.
Organization roles SHALL include OWNER, ADMIN, MEMBER.
Demonstrate the scoped authorized workflow and applicable denial, retry/lifecycle and UXA-01–08 checks; retain exact revision results and integrate with no known critical regression.
